access.deduplication: Adjacent to truckee-river-crystal-peak-mayberry at Crystal Peak Park. It shares one endpoint but no route miles.

scoring.thresholdSourceStrength: official state recreation guide, based on its community route guidance
scoring.disclaimer: 700 cfs is a minimum-only score preference from the route guide, never a safety guarantee. The guide warns diversions can leave sections dry even above that gauge value.

safety: Advanced Class III-IV route with long sections lacking convenient exits.
Scout or portage Floriston Gorge, Jaws, Bronco, Headhunter/Fleish Dam, Dead Man's Curve, Steamboat Canal and Verdi Diversion.
Check route-wide water continuity and diversion operations, not only one gauge; spring flows increase force and reduce bridge clearance.
Watch for rebar, concrete, trees, strainers, cold water, private banks, railroad property and cross-state access rules.

camping.notes: Day run; the state guide says camping is not allowed at Crystal Peak Park. No other authorized on-route campsite is confirmed.

gallery.notes: Visually reviewed as a real Truckee River scene near the Crystal Peak end; caption explicitly says it does not depict the upper rapids or current conditions.
